dogecoin.text:
The blue-eyed beast roamed abandoned wallets,  
sniffing through broken contracts,  
howling into the void.

He was rejected by every pack.  
$DOGE said he barked too loud.  
$WIF said he looked too wild.

They laughed.

He didn’t.
